reviewType: Independent copy review only; no scored or nonce-bound delivery gate
reviewerScope: Last 53 documents sorted by slug; writerB proposals; zero overlap with reviewer-authored editorial-a proposals
observations: Recommendations decisively favor supported WhatFlow Shopify order messaging and consented WhatsApp conversations, while retaining specific channel, service, CRM and implementation exceptions.
Competitor user bundles and seat definitions remain accurate, including Zoko unlimited Starter agents and TimelinesAI connecting-account seats rather than every inbox collaborator.

Pricing caveats remain explicit: Plivo eligible spend and future effective dates, Telnyx calling-versus-messaging terms, distinct contact/ticket/conversation/message units and Meta charges separate from app allowances.

Channel articles retain audience reach and preference limits, channel-specific permission, SMS fallback scope, non-equivalence of reads and outcomes, and accurate review-provider verification responsibility.
COD copy preserves the distinction between a delivered message, a customer decision, checkout configuration and separately authorized fulfillment.
Deletion review found redundant promotional or alternative recommendation copy removed without losing the distinct exercises, budgets, evidence links or required tradeoff explanations.
The free button is not presented as unlimited free automated delivery; official Cloud API is described as a foundation rather than immunity from restrictions.
limits: This review uses the supplied source documents, proposals, audit and previously verified research context; it is not a fresh network recertification of every changing vendor term.
Assets were not ready and Chrome was unavailable for this review; screenshot accuracy, final composition, mobile layout, accessibility and performance remain unassessed here.
No final score, review nonce, visual gate, technical gate or publication clearance is issued by this copy review.

Reader-specific audience preference and measurable business outcomes still require the actual operating context; the recommendations are scoped editorial judgments, not comparative performance measurements.
